title: Lemma 4.7: n-coherence descends along closed immersions of infinity-topoi
statement_scope: Let X be an ∞-topos and let f*:Y→X be a closed immersion of ∞-topoi. If X is n-coherent for some n≥0, then Y is n-coherent. The statement is retained whole, with the author's induction on n and both the n=0 quasi-compactness case and the n>0 coherence case.
